# pangolin_org_idp (Resource)

Manages an OIDC Identity Provider scoped to a single Pangolin organization.

This is the single-resource equivalent of combining `pangolin_idp` (system-wide create) + `pangolin_idp_org` (bind to an org): the upstream `/org/{org}/idp/oidc` endpoint auto-binds the new IDP to the calling org at creation time, removing the need for a separate binding resource.

> **Note:** `client_secret` cannot be recovered after import and must be set manually in config to avoid spurious diffs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_org_idp" "authentik" {
  org_id          = "my-org"
  name            = "Authentik"
  client_id       = "pangolin"
  client_secret   = var.oidc_client_secret
  auth_url        = "https://auth.example.com/application/o/authorize/"
  token_url       = "https://auth.example.com/application/o/token/"
  identifier_path = "sub"
  email_path      = "email"
  name_path       = "name"
  scopes          = "openid email profile"
  variant         = "oidc"
  auto_provision  = true

  # Per-org token-claim → role mapping (optional)
  role_mapping = "'Member'"
}

output "oidc_redirect_url" {
  description = "Configure this URL as the OAuth callback in your OIDC provider."
  value       = pangolin_org_idp.authentik.redirect_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_url` (String) The OIDC authorization URL.
- `client_id` (String) The OIDC client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OIDC client secret.
- `identifier_path` (String) The path in the ID token to use as the user identifier (e.g. `sub`).
- `name` (String) The display name of the IDP.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the organization this IDP is bound to.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated OIDC scopes (e.g. `openid email profile`).
- `token_url` (String) The OIDC token URL.

### Optional

- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Whether to auto-provision users on first login. Defaults to `false`.
- `email_path` (String) The path in the ID token for the user email.
- `name_path` (String) The path in the ID token for the user display name.
- `org_mapping` (String) Optional expression mapping a token claim to the org binding. Null when unset.
- `role_mapping` (String) Optional expression mapping a token claim to a Pangolin role for this org. Null when unset.
- `tags` (String) Optional tags associated with the IDP.
- `variant` (String) OIDC variant - refines `type = oidc` to a provider family. One of `oidc` (generic, default), `google`, `azure`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric IDP ID.
- `redirect_url` (String) The OAuth callback URL to configure in your OIDC provider. Only returned on create - empty after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: "{org_id}/{idp_id}"
#
# Note: `client_secret` cannot be recovered after import - set it
# manually in config to avoid a spurious diff on the next plan.
terraform import pangolin_org_idp.authentik my-org/3
```
